name: AXM Game Production Runner
actions: run an explicit game fixture candidate
run an explicit portable-profile fixture candidate
run an explicit content-verified documentation candidate
reuse an explicit external verified artifact cache
invalidate one exact cache entry explicitly
discover cache references from sealed terminal ledgers read-only
apply one exact approved cache retention proposal
probe trusted Hand confinement substrate explicitly
summary: Compile locked intent into exact production packages and run bounded game or portable-profile candidate work with independent evidence and no automatic installation.
notes: v0.1 executes inert fixtures plus one trusted in-process deterministic documentation Hand. An opt-in external cache reuses only executors declaring deterministic-v1, verifies immutable entry bytes, and reruns the current appointed verifier on every hit; tamper or disagreement falls back to fresh execution. A bounded read-only adapter derives path-private reference sets only from fully validated terminal run receipts and their complete digest-chained ledgers. The separate on-demand retention governor binds exact key/entry digests and freshly rescans both references and cache state before an explicitly approved deletion with readback. Nothing schedules or applies retention automatically. The confinement probe remains diagnostic and held. Native Godot production remains separately gated and unclaimed.
